programme.desc: The Holiday Meal. It's a traditional American meal with a modern twist. Ina Garten's 100% stress-free holiday meal includes roast turkey, smashed sweet potatoes and spinach gratin. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Festive Fun. Ina is making something with a festive theme, as she is throwing a dazzling dinner party featuring a luxurious seafood gratin of lobster in a golden saffron sauce. S10, Ep8

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Perfect Holiday Dinner. Ina creates a menu for a student-entertaining blog site featuring chicken with goat's cheese and sun-dried tomato, amongst other delicious dishes. S2, Ep11

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Veggie Christmas
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge shares his meat-free recipes for Christmas! The mouth-watering menu includes his puff pastry parcel, ultimate veggie gravy, and white chocolate trifle.

programme.title: James Martin's Christmas Feasts
programme.desc: Chef James Martin creates a special Christmas menu. He serves up figs and apple chutney, Yorkshire pot with creamed leeks, Stollen cake and biscotti. S1, Ep1

programme.title: James Martin: Sweet
programme.desc: Festive. James Martin puts festive desserts under the spotlight. He focuses on the staples - sugar, cream, strawberries and fresh fruit. But, which festive desserts will he make? S1, Ep14

programme.title: James Martin And Christmas Friends
programme.desc: James Martin invites some of his celebrity friends round for a festive feast. He's joined by actor Jimi Mistry and chef Paul Ainsworth gives his take on a Christmas lunch. S1, Ep1

programme.title: James Martin And Christmas Friends
programme.desc: James Martin invites chef Brian Turner and actor Jennie McAlpine round for a festive feast including shoulder of pork. Plus, Ching-He Huang cooks a yuletide Asian treat. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Michel Roux: Christmas in Provence
programme.desc: Michel cooks the best produce Southern France has to offer. Friends and family join the festivities as he serves up delicious Christmas dishes and the perfect festive drinks.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers: Mums Know Best At Christmas
programme.desc: The Bikers travel the UK in search of the most amazing Christmas dishes that Britain's mums are cooking for their families, culminating in a special festive banquet.

programme.title: Hairy Bikers At Christmas
programme.desc: The biking duo team up to throw an epic Christmas dinner for their combined families. They take a road trip along the Pennines in search of the best produce for their feast.

programme.title: Hairy Bikers' Twelve Days Of Christmas
programme.desc: The Hairy Bikers take a delicious culinary journey through the verses of one of the most popular Christmas songs, and take part in some of the best festive traditions!

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers' Christmas Party
programme.desc: Si King and Dave Myers throw a Christmas party and cook for family, friends and some of the people they've met on the road over the last few years.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Christmas Suppers
programme.desc: Culinary champion Nigel Slater reveals fantastic festive recipes, including transforming any left-over bird into his scrumptious perky turkey dish.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking Christmas Special
programme.desc: Nigel Slater reveals fantastic festive recipes, including a sumptuous casserole, that will warm cockles and fill hungry stomachs throughout the Christmas period.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's 12 Tastes Of Christmas
programme.desc: Nigel Slater shares his favourite festive dishes, from tempting treats to a feast on the big day. And, in Norway he sees how Scandinavian flavours capture the essence of Christmas.

programme.title: Nigella's Christmas Bites
programme.desc: Domestic goddess, Nigella Lawson, prepares her favourite festive food. She shares her tips on how to reduce the stress and increase the pleasure in making Christmas dishes.

programme.title: Gok Wan's Easy Asian: Christmas Special
programme.desc: Gok shares his best recipes for a sumptuous Christmas Day feast. Delicious dishes include a decadent lobster stir fry, Chinese roast duck and a spiced Christmas pudding.

programme.title: Gok Wan's Easy Asian Christmas
programme.desc: Gok shares his best recipes for a fabulous Christmas Day feast. Delicious dishes include indulgent French toast with an Asian twist, and belly pork with honey and soy sauce.

programme.title: ITV News; Weather
programme.desc: A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents

programme.title: The Proposition
programme.desc: Drama. Director: John Hillcoat. Stars John Hurt, Guy Pearce & Ray Winstone. A lawman gives an outlaw nine days to kill his older brother, or they'll execute his younger brother.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: All Good Friends: The Case of the Handless Corpse. 1992. Stars Suzanne Packer & Michelle Chadwick. Based on the 1979 case, where two divers found the body of a man in a flooded Lancashire quarry.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1994. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes and Jean Paul Gaultier. Travel to Berlin to meet the adults who like to dress as babies and the women who look after them. Join supermodel Eva Herzigova as a judge!

programme.title: Another Day, Another Man
programme.desc: Drama. Director: Doris Wishman. Stars Agustin Mayor, Barbara Kemp & Sam Stewart. A young couple are burdened with financial troubles until the wife meets a seedy pimp who can help.

programme.title: This Week of Grace
programme.desc: 1933. Comedy. Directed by Maurice Elvey. Starring Gracie Fields, Henry Kendall & John Stuart. A poor, unemployed woman is made housekeeper at the estate of a wealthy duchess.

programme.title: Lena Rivers
programme.desc: 1932. Drama starring Charlotte Henry, Morgan Galloway and Beryl Mercer. Young Lena, born out of wedlock, goes to live with a rich uncle, but his wife and daughter don't like her one bit.

programme.title: Look At Life Laying the Table
programme.desc: 1967. A fascinating look at the changing shape of the table, with different designs in pottery, glass and cutlery.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Kingfishers/Model Carts. 1986. Jack Hargreaves visits a man who has rescued kingfishers from a flooded river and then looks at the work of an unknown model maker.

programme.title: They Came to a City
programme.desc: 1944. Fantasy. Directed by Basil Dearden. Stars John Clements, Googie Withers & Raymond Huntley. Nine people from different walks of life find themselves transported to a mysterious city.

programme.title: Suspect
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Directed by Roy Boulting and John Boulting. Stars Tony Britton, Virginia Maskell, Peter Cushing. A young scientist's pioneering work attracts the attention of the authorities.

programme.title: The Outlaw's Daughter
programme.desc: 1954. Western. Directed by Wesley Barry. Stars Bill Williams, Kelly Ryan & Jim Davis. The 'outlaw's daughter', Kate Dalton, is led astray by the man who killed her father and joins his gang.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts Go Hollywood. 1963. Stars Buddy Ebsen, King Donovan & Shirley Mitchell. Jake and Opal continue to stay at the Clampett mansion. Jake thinks he can make a movie with Jed's money.

programme.title: The Railway Children
programme.desc: 2000. Drama. Directed by Catherine Morshead. Stars Jenny Agutter & Richard Attenborough. Three children are forced to move to Yorkshire with their mother after their father is falsely imprisoned.

programme.title: Miss MacTaggart Won't Lie Down
programme.desc: 1966. Comedy. Directed by Francis A Searle. Stars Barbara Mullen and Eric Woodburn. A spinster has been proclaimed dead - but is very much alive...

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Cities
programme.desc: 1958. Drama. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Dorothy Tutin, Cecil Parker & Stephen Murray. During the French Revolution, Lucie Manette falls in love with a duplicitous Englishman.

programme.title: Look At Life A Year for a Day
programme.desc: 1961. A look into the business of Christmas and the individuals who spend most of the year contributing to the festivities.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Fame and the Fury. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Patrick Holt & Sandra Dome. Celia's partner is a struggling painter. But when she leaves him for a wealthier man, she soon realises her mistake.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Noel and Mike have some festive footage for you in this Christmas special! From magical vintage animations brimming with Yuletide charm to Fanny Cradock making a mince pie!

programme.title: The Halfway House
programme.desc: 1944. Drama. Directed by Basil Dearden. Starring Mervyn Johns, Glynis Johns & Tom Walls. A group of travellers, all with something to hide in their past, take shelter from a storm in an old inn.

programme.title: Memories of Making Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: Acclaimed actor William Gaunt shares his memories of co-star on Sergeant Cork, John Barrie.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
